title: A song about a ford
prose: Late, when the jar has gone round twice, one of the band sings about a ford where the water ran backwards for a day and a whole caravan crossed dry. Everybody joins in on the part where the salt carriers fall in. They have clearly sung it a hundred times, and they are still delighted by it.

choices.label: Join in on the chorus
choices.line: You get the words wrong and nobody minds. By the third time you have them.

choices.label: Listen
choices.line: You listen, and laugh where they laugh. It is not a kind song, and it is a very good one.

notes: A fireside story for a night slept beside a camp of dacoits (Roads and Hands, phase 5). Shared by every map, as the owner's four camp kinds are. Drafted for the owner to rewrite or approve.
